title: TAND - a Point-and-Click Adventure
author: AkahitoDE
selftext:
Hi! This is the trailer for **TAND**, a point-and-click adventure I made for Café Jam 2026 (theme: "One Last Night").

*Tand* is an old German word for trinkets – worthless stuff nobody needs any more. In this game, that's the toys.

One afternoon, a child plays with a new toy built from leftover wooden blocks. "Go on, your turn!" Then someone calls from downstairs, the child has to go, and the lid closes. "I'll be right back."

The box ends up in the attic. Dust, cold, silence. The toys up there have been waiting for decades, some for nearly a hundred years, and they still live by the rules of old children's games. Nobody remembers those rules were ever part of a game. *We sit out. Keep still when it creaks. No laughing, no turning round.* Whoever doesn't play for too long stays down. Whoever plays too loudly brings something on.

The New One doesn't know any of that. He knows one afternoon and one sentence: "Your turn!" And he's sure the child will be back any minute. It did say "right back".

**What's in it**

* Puzzles built from old children's games: dominoes, a die, a counting rhyme, hide-and-seek, Red Light, Green Light
* Fully voiced in English and German – over 2,000 lines per language, around twenty characters
* A 3D world at toy scale
* Prologue, five chapters and an epilogue
* Hints if you get stuck (you can switch them off)
* Windows, mouse only

  
The Game launches on 11.01.2026, and we can't wait to here your feedback \~
